sql:
SELECT
  t0.entity_schema AS entity_schema,
  t0.entity_table AS entity_table,
  t0.retention_days AS retention_days,
  t0.action_on_expiry AS action_on_expiry,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t0.tenant_id) AS tenant_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t0.is_active THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t0.last_run_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS never_run_count
FROM retention_policies t0
GROUP BY
  t0.entity_schema,
  t0.entity_table,
  t0.retention_days,
  t0.action_on_expiry
ORDER BY
  t0.entity_table ASC,
  tenant_count DESC,
  t0.entity_schema ASC,
  t0.retention_days ASC,
  t0.action_on_expiry ASC

note: Grain is (entity_schema, entity_table, retention_days, action_on_expiry) as requested; active_count and never_run_count are counts of policy rows (one per tenant) within that combination that are active / never run, not distinct tenant counts, since a tenant could in principle differ on those flags while matching the same rule shape.
